description: The file defines the SuiteBeanResource class, which converts SugarBean objects to JSON API resource representations, and vice versa. It handles attribute mapping, relationship management, file uploads, and conversions between SugarBeans and resource objects within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: SuiteBeanResource
classes.description: Handles conversion between SugarBean objects and JSON API resource representations, managing attributes, relationships, files, and resource validation.

methods.name: fromSugarBean
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean object into a SuiteBeanResource, mapping fields, handling special types, and setting relationships.

methods.name: toSugarBean
methods.description: Converts the SuiteBeanResource back into a SugarBean, handling relationships and saving files.

methods.name: fromJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Populates the resource from a JSON API request array.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Copies data from a generic Resource to a SuiteBeanResource.

methods.name: withRelationship
methods.description: Associates a Relationship object with this resource.

methods.name: retrieveFileFromBean
methods.description: Reads a file associated with a bean and encodes it as a base64 string for API response.

methods.name: saveFileToBean
methods.description: Uploads a base64-encoded file and associates it with a bean, handling revisions if necessary.
